verdict.rationale: Ramp's official MCP server lets users connect Claude, ChatGPT and similar assistants to "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language." Documented examples include checking card balances, requesting reimbursements, approving transactions and getting policy answers, all respecting roles and landing in the audit log. A live probe confirms the OAuth-gated server at mcp.ramp.com with granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: bill approvals are not yet available via MCP; there is no native in-product natural-language command interface (natural language runs through third-party assistants); and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
